'''Karlus Stee''' was a fair skinned [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|black]] [[hair]], who worked as a croupier at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> he was managing a [[Hazard Toss]] table in the [[casino]] where [[Count]] [[Sosear Latta]] scored a perfect [[cross-cap]], which earned a cheer from a crowd of humans watching. Stee watched Latta closely as he played to ensure the count was not cheating, but believed he was playing cleanly. The croupier wore a green [[Clothing|waistcoat]] with yellow patterning in casino livery over a white shirt with a red [[shimmersilk]] [[Belt|cumberbund]], as well as black pants with red and yellow patterning and a green [[hat]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karlus Stee first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
